key_insights: Market is at monthly resistance on both BTC and ETH with no clear breakout evidence
Busy week of headline risk including rate decisions and earnings creates uncertainty
Momentum continuation trades are less favorable near resistance vs support
Critical support for BTC is 20K, failure would invalidate bullish arguments
No evidence of decoupling from traditional markets, macro events remain relevant
summary: BTC and ETH are at monthly resistance levels (BTC at 23.3K, ETH at 1760-1780) with no clear breakout evidence amid a week of significant macro headlines. The speakers recommend patience, waiting for either a reclaim of resistance levels or a pullback to support (20K for BTC, 1500 for ETH). Altcoins are underperforming with no altcoin season expected.
